notes: The agent correctly identified the gap in the trace runner (it assumed materialized snapshots but approval-gated traces have zero), then implemented the required support with comprehensive coverage: optional stages, commit expectations, approval-gated manifest, tests, and documentation updates. Verification was thorough (validate, accepted demo trace, approval-gated trace, full tests, drift check). Decomposition into a FLIP subtask appears intentional for follow-up work rather than incompleteness. Strengths: pressure testing before build, systematic verification, proper drift checks, 3-minute turnaround. Weaknesses: no artifacts recorded in task system (makes downstream handoff unclear), original task has empty acceptance criteria (makes verification criteria implicit), the FLIP subtask's relationship to parent completion is ambiguous (is it a follow-up or blocking issue?). The work appears technically sound and properly tested, but poor artifact documentation and subtle task status ambiguity reduce downstream usability and coordination clarity.
